attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 4 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives no year. The corpus keeps no Asclepia: the five near names the sweep returned are Asclepiodote of Marcianopolis, Asklepiodote and her companions on 19 February, and Asklepios the disciple of Polychronius — different names, different days. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
